target_graph_constraints.endpoint_semantics: stored pairs use pose-table indices; optimizer edges use reduced graph-node indices

transaction_accounting.interpretation: Host TX/RX byte totals count completed full-duplex testbench transfers; target frames count completed fixed-size receives. Neither detects unclocked commands or identifies drops of identical sequence-less commands.

spi_diagnostics.counter_semantics: Cumulative since target boot; uint32 counters wrap modulo 2^32. Frames count only completed pi_spi_receive calls.

gazebo_source.claim_boundary: In-flight Gazebo telemetry was streamed over the bounded Unix socket into GAP9 production firmware under GVSOC during the same mission run. This validates live firmware receipt during simulated Crazyflie flight; the Crazyflie STM32 flight controller is not executed, and mapping accuracy is not validated.

limitations: Exercises the production command path over GVSOC SPI2 ingress with 60 poses.
Does not validate map accuracy, physical SPI, or onboard flight control.
Receive counters cannot detect frames for which no clocks were observed, and sequence-less identical commands cannot be distinguished as dropped or duplicated.

In-flight Gazebo telemetry was streamed over the bounded IPC socket into GAP9 production firmware under GVSOC. This validates live firmware receipt during simulated flight, not execution of Crazyflie STM32 flight-control firmware or mapping accuracy.
